summary: Movado Group Inc. filed an 8-K reporting Amendment No. 7 to its Credit Agreement, a routine refinancing of its revolving credit facility. The amendment extends maturity to July 2031, reduces commitments from $100M to $75M, eliminates a 0.10% SOFR adjustment, and increases interest margins by 0.10%. As of the date, no loans were drawn and ~$299,000 in letters of credit were outstanding, leaving ~$74.7M availability. This is a standard credit facility amendment, not a special situation. No deal terms apply.
